question.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

exchange.sent: What evidence is required to compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
To compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense, we need a same-scope evidence bundle: a directly stated A&D use case, formal R&S product/configuration evidence, formal competitor product/configuration evidence, and identical test methods, options, versions, limits, and conditions; internal battle cards or separate co-mentions are not enough for unsupported superiority claims [7][11][57][81].
### Evidence required
| Evidence required | What it must contain | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| A direct Aerospace / Defense use-case source | The source must name the A&D scenario, DUT or application, and the required Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer roles in that same context [97][99]. | The provided raw material shows an “Aerospace & Defense Test” context in one slide and separately lists “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer,” but it does not itself provide a complete competitor comparison [97][99]. | Current passages do not provide a single supported R&S-vs-competitor A&D Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer comparison [97][99]. |
| Formal R&S Signal Generator evidence | R&S SMW200A evidence should come from the configuration guide and specifications, including document code, version, date, mandatory configuration, ordering information, options, RF/baseband performance, interfaces, and environmental data [2]. | SMW200A product data is conditioned on storage, warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments, and only specified/warranted data should be used as binding performance evidence [3]. | SMW200A facts available include architecture, up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth with wideband baseband, and up to 800 MHz channel emulation bandwidth with integrated fading, subject to option licensing and configuration [1]. |
| Formal R&S Signal Analyzer evidence | R&S FSW evidence should use the FSW specifications document PD 5215.6749.22, Version 17.01, September 2025, noting that data without tolerance limits is not binding and specifications may change [67]. | FSW product data also depends on storage, warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments, so comparison claims need the same conditions and calibration basis [66]. | FSW model frequency ranges and order numbers are available from FSW8 through FSW85, including FSW85 with FSW-B90G extension to 90 GHz [69]. |
| R&S option stack and configuration evidence | The comparison must list exact R&S options, order numbers where available, bandwidth options, firmware/license options, and compatibility limits rather than only naming the platform [6][70]. | SMW200A ordering requires at least an RF path A frequency option and a signal routing/baseband main module, and RF path A frequency options cannot be retrofitted [65]. | Recommended or solution-level configurations are not a quotable BOM unless checked against configuration guides, option availability, export control, and service plans [81]. |
| Application-level R&S evidence for the specific test | If the A&D use case is satellite payload/component testing, R&S application evidence states that FSW + SMW200A is positioned for complete payload testing, while ZNA is positioned for component-level testing [28][43]. | For group delay, the cited method uses SMW200A to generate a multicarrier continuous-wave stimulus and FSW to perform reference calibration and DUT group delay/gain measurement [29]. | This supports satellite payload/component testing, but it does not by itself prove a broader A&D market comparison or competitor superiority [43]. |
| Competitor official product evidence | For Keysight, the evidence must include Keysight official datasheets or third-party data validating SKU specs, document version, order number, option code, release status, and test conditions [7]. | The Keysight battle card is an R&S source, and the knowledge base says its Keysight competitor descriptions require Keysight official or third-party verification [7]. | The Keysight page records the R&S battle-card view only and states it is not Keysight official data [74]. |
| Competitor official product evidence if Anritsu is the competitor | For Anritsu, frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option code, software tools, and support model must be verified with Anritsu official datasheets, release notes, or support terms [11]. | The Anritsu page says its current content is based on an R&S internal battle card and that Anritsu weakness narratives cannot be treated as Anritsu official specifications or market facts [11]. | The battle card lists Anritsu products and weakness narratives, but the passages do not provide Anritsu official datasheet versions or validated option stacks [76][77]. |
| Same test method and measurement conditions | The comparison must state identical DUT, waveform, frequency range, bandwidth, detector or measurement mode, uncertainty, calibration interval, environmental conditions, and pass/fail criteria where applicable [3][66]. | Product data conditions differ from informal application claims, and solution-level slide claims must not replace formal datasheets or configuration guides [57]. | Equipment recommendation passages warn that formal frequency range, options, uncertainty, and test method must be checked in product datasheets [19][22]. |
| Standards and regulatory basis, if the comparison is about compliance | The comparison must cite exact applicable standards or regulations, test items, versions, and measurement scope, such as FCC/ANSI/IEEE items or 3GPP conformance chapters where relevant [53][54][55][60]. | A standards claim is not the same as a product capability claim, and each supported instrument/option configuration still needs product evidence [57]. | Some sources list regulatory or 3GPP test contexts, but they also include unresolved limits such as missing standard versions, test methods, or accepted evidence details [52]. |
| Claim boundaries for market, ecosystem, TCO, or superiority | Claims such as market dominance, ecosystem partnerships, “only vendor,” R&S superiority, or lower TCO require external evidence and cannot be based only on internal battle-card positioning [7][11]. | The Keysight unresolved section says ecosystem partnerships, market dominance, NTN/RedCap/FR3/6G path claims lack traceable external evidence [7]. | The Anritsu page says R&S superiority, only-vendor, and lower-TCO statements are sales positioning rather than directly citable technical specifications [11]. |
### Minimum evidence package before making the comparison
1. A single A&D scenario definition naming the DUT, test objective, frequency range, bandwidth, signal type, environment, and whether the role is signal generation, signal analysis, or both [97][99].  
2. R&S SMW200A and FSW formal datasheet/configuration evidence with document versions, option codes, order numbers where available, performance conditions, and warranted versus non-warranted data clearly separated [2][3][6][67].  
3. Competitor official datasheets, release notes, configuration guides, support terms, or third-party measurements for the exact competing model and option stack [7][11].  
4. A common test method with the same DUT, setup, calibration status, environmental conditions, uncertainty basis, waveform, bandwidth, frequency range, and pass/fail criteria [3][66][19][22].  
5. External proof for any non-technical claims such as market leadership, ecosystem reach, roadmap advantage, support superiority, or TCO [7][11][74].  
### Unsupported without more evidence
A claim that our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution is better than a competitor for Aerospace / Defense is not supported by the provided passages unless the exact competitor, A&D use case, R&S configuration, competitor configuration, and common test conditions are documented in directly comparable sources [7][11][57][81].

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。

Keysight
[[Keysight]]（圖中亦寫作 [[是德科技]]）是在既有 PCB 測試圖像來源中被列為高頻高速 [[PCB]] 測試解決方案相關公司的測試量測廠商名稱；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中，Keysight 也被描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor 與 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 wireless device testing 競品供應商。

Keysight › R&S 2026-02-26 battle card 中的 Keysight 描述
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Keysight 被描述為 large US-based test & measurement vendor，總部位於 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**。
- 來源說 Keysight 在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具 strong market presence。
- 來源說 Keysight 在美國與 key semiconductor accounts 很強，並宣稱有 broad ecosystem partnerships：24/25 top tech companies、14/15 operators、25/25 semiconductor companies。
- 來源列出 Keysight portfolio：[[Keysight UXM]] 5G Wireless Test Platforms（[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]）、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源說 Keysight UXM portfolio fragmented across multiple hardware SKUs，每個 SKU 有不同 bandwidth、RF ports、Wi-Fi、Rel-17/18 capabilities。
- 來源說 Keysight software model 分散於 Atlas、Channel Studio、RaySim、Nemo、WLAN tools 與 UXM-specific feature options，並稱 no unified automation environment。
- 來源說 Keysight support model 使用 tiered [[KeysightCare]] model：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support，另有 optional warranty and calibration assurance plan。

Anritsu
[[Anritsu]] 是一間日本 test & measurement vendor；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中被描述為 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 的競品供應商。

- Anritsu 產品的 frequency range、bandwidth、data rate、option code、software tools 與 support model 需要另以 Anritsu 官方 datasheet / release notes / support terms 驗證。

- Headquarters：Kanagawa, Japan。
- Company size：約 4,000+ employees global。
- Market positioning：source 稱其在 Japan T&M market share 為 #1，但 global footprint 較弱。
- Strengths：good LTE/eCall signaling（[[Anritsu MD8475B]]）、solid RF heritage、strong Japanese operator relationships。
- Support model：traditional hardware service；source 評為 software ecosystem 較弱、cloud capabilities limited，且 TestDeck 是唯一 DX tool。

以上為 R&S internal battle card 對競品的描述；來源未引用 Anritsu 官方文件或第三方市場資料。

NTN signal generator solutions › 與 NTN validation / conformance 的關係
- [[5G NTN validation and testing]]：較寬的 NTN validation、partner collaboration、CMX500 / SMBV100B / Viasat / Gatehouse / MediaTek PR 語境。
- [[NR-NTN conformance testing]]：偏 UE / GCF / PTCRB / TS8980 / CMX500 conformance validation。
- [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]：本來源新增的 Satellite Access Node 測試概念，聚焦 SAN transmitter、receiver、performance 與 OTA chapters。
- [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]]：既有 CMX500 PR 中 propagation emulation 與 fading 的概念；本來源補充 SMW200A dynamic fading / Doppler / path delay 實作線索。

NTN signal generator solutions
[[NTN signal generator solutions]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025；末頁標示 Last updated: 08/25）中用來整理 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]] 與相關 software options 在 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 測試中的 solution-level 應用框架。

NTN signal generator solutions › 來源中的 solution 分層
[[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] 將 NTN testing 分為四類：

- Component Testing。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）Testing。
- End-to-end System Testing。
- User Equipment（UE）Testing。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 典型 setup 元件
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 的 TVAC test setup 可包含：

- signal generator
- RF switching matrix
- signal analyzer
- network analyzer
- multimeter
- DC power system
- laptop / PC remote operation
- test interface
- TVAC
- satellite or satellite components
- bulkhead connector interface

來源標示 TVAC setup 中距離為 10 m to 25 m。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 測試問題
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- Satellite payload qualification 需要使用 [[TVAC]] 進行 performance testing。
- Commercial off-the-shelf test and measurement equipment 無法在 TVAC conditions 下工作。
- Spectrum analyzers、vector network analyzers、signal generators 等設備必須留在 TVAC 外部，並以長 cables 連接 chamber 內的 DUT。
- Test setup 中的 cables、adapters 與 switches 會隨 TVAC temperature changes 發生 drift。
- 在不同 temperature 下於 chamber 中完成的 calibration 不再有效。
- 移動 cables 與改變 temperatures 後，需要 regular recalibration 以確保 measurement accuracy。
- TVAC 內 calibration procedure 特別困難，因 vacuum applied 時 operator 無法進入 chamber。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

- 與 [[R&S CMX500]]：既有頁面整理 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 Radio Communication Tester、NR / LTE / WLAN signaling、fading、application test 與 automation 平台。本來源只提到 CMX customers 與 5G test setup，沒有明示硬體型號、option 或配置，因此不能把測試結果歸因為正式 CMX500 規格或能力。

- 與 [[5G NTN validation and testing]]、[[NTN propagation emulation and fading]]：本來源處理 private / tactical 5G resilience 與 jamming，不是 NTN channel emulation 或 satellite validation；兩者都屬 contested / non-terrestrial / mission-critical 連線可靠性脈絡，但不可混用測試條件。

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 [[Randy Schnell]] 製作 / 主講的 company restricted 簡報，題為 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient；raw frontmatter 顯示原檔為 `2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`，轉檔日期為 2026-09-17。來源正文沒有另外標示正式發布日期；本頁以檔名 / raw title 的 2025-12-19 作為來源日期線索。

簡報主張的核心問題是：在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，能否利用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] 能力，讓 unmodified 5G DUT connection 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具韌性。

主要內容如下：

- 任務背景：tactical edge connectivity 對資料與低延遲需求提高，[[Smart Jamming]] 與 electronic warfare（[[EW]]）威脅增加，private [[5G]] networks 在 military bases / tactical environments 的採用升高。
- 技術映射：來源將問題映射到 5G handover（[[HO]]）signaling 與 frequency-hopping（[[FH]]）signaling；測試設計需使用 [[UE]] capabilities message 回報的 supported bands，並關注 [[3GPP TS 38.300]] 定義的 handover interruption intervals。
- 測試結果：來源聲稱 both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；throughput 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 支撐 video-call reliability 維持，但投影片 OCR 未提供具體 throughput、jitter、packet loss、bandwidth、jammer profile 或 modem 型號數值。
- 現有 defense / Future-G program 脈絡：來源列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]]、[[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing 等項目，說明 FHSS / frequency-agile operation 與 5G / 6G coexistence 的整合方向。
- 時程展望：來源給出 short term 2025–2028、mid term 2028–2032、long term 2032–2035+ 三段式展望，包含 5G tactical networks scale-out、mmWave phased arrays field testing、5G/6G-capable SD radios、early ISAC for drone detection / perimeter defense、URLLC for autonomy、full 6G with integrated sensing、AI-native battlefield connectivity 與 spectrum-aware autonomy。
- Call to action：重新接觸既有 CMX customers，尤其 DOW customers；與 integrators 溝通；保持 tactical patience；提早 engage BDM organization；跨團隊分享 lessons learned。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

SDR-assisted UAV security › GPS spoofing / jamming detection
來源指出 affordable SDR devices，如 [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF 2.0]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，可用於 GNSS spoofing / jamming attacks，也可用於測試 defense mechanisms：

- [62] 提出 lightweight LSTM-based detection model，並以 knowledge distillation 壓縮，利於整合進 UAV control systems。
- [63] 研究 [[HackRF One]] 1.0 與 external TCXO 對 GNSS signal spoofing / jamming threats 的影響；受測 UAV GNSS receivers 包含 3DR IRIS+、Tarot 650 v2.2、DJI Inspire、Sky Hunter。
- [64] [[MAVIDS]] 使用 PCA 與 one-class classifiers，並以 [[HackRF One]]、[[GPS-SDR-SIM]] 與 [[GNU Radio Companion]] 進行 GPS spoofing / jamming experiments；macro-averaged F1 scores 為 GPS spoofing 90.57%、jamming 94.3%。
- [66] 使用 cellular BS 與 Wi-Fi AP crowd-sourced information 進行 GPS spoofing detection / mitigation，並以 [[HackRF One]] + TCXO 產生 spoofing signals。

SDR-assisted UAV security › unresolved
- 各 jamming / spoofing research 的法規授權、測試場地許可與 safety controls 未在本次摘要中完整展開。
- 來源沒有把 SDR-assisted security solutions 對應到商用產品 maturity level。
- [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF x40]]、[[Ettus USRP X310]] 等 device 在不同研究中的配置、firmware、clocking、antenna 與 calibration 條件需逐篇回查。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：文件頁尾 copyright owner，© 2017–2022，地址標示 81671 Munich, Germany。
- [[R&S FSW]]：用於 group delay、linearity、NPR、signal quality、spurious、carrier-in-carrier 與 oscillator / synthesizer measurements；來源列 key features 為 up to 90 GHz、up to 500 GHz with external harmonic mixers、up to 8.3 GHz internal analysis bandwidth、800 MHz real-time analysis bandwidth。
- [[R&S SMW200A]]：用於 multi-carrier / modulated signal generation、OFDM waveform generation、DPD、NPR stimulus；來源列 key features 為 up to 67 GHz、up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth、with [[R&S SMW-K555]] 可達 4 GHz signal bandwidth、optional second RF path up to 44 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：用於 payload components RF measurements、converter / mixer group delay、noise figure、amplifier/filter/antenna measurements；來源列 key features 包含 up to 67 GHz、up to eight independent receivers、four phase coherent sources、two internal LO sources、internal combiner。
- [[R&S FS-SNS]]：smart noise source，用於簡化 spectrum analyzer 的 noise figure and gain measurements。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]：TVAC-compatible automatic calibration unit，可放在 chamber 內做 inline recalibration。
- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 與 [[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：TVAC-designed three-path diode power sensors，分別支援 up to 33 GHz / 67 GHz。
- [[R&S RTP]]、[[R&S RTO6]]：oscilloscopes，用於 satellite digital interface trigger、decode 與 debug。

- Wideband baseband B13XT + B9：B15 fading emulator up to 64 fading channels、up to 800 MHz fading bandwidth per carrier、up to 800 MHz aggregated bandwidth。

NTN signaling customer discovery › 4. Satellite architecture
來源詢問：

- 是否將 CMX 連接到 [[satellite gateway]]，在 real live satellite network 中測試。
- gateway 使用哪些 bands。

R&S SMW200A › 主要 RF performance（Version 31.00，May 2026）
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Frequency range：依 RF path frequency option，RF path A 最高 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`；RF path B 最高 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- Overrange：`67 GHz to 72 GHz`。
- Resolution of setting：`0.001 Hz`。
- Resolution of synthesis：`0.053 nHz nominal`，條件 `f = 1 GHz`。
- Frequency setting time：依 frequency option 為 `< 1.2 ms` 至 `< 1.8 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` 為 `< 4.0 ms`。條件包含 GUI update stopped、I/Q optimization mode fast、after IEC/IEEE bus delimiter、HUMS off。
- Frequency setting time in list mode：依 frequency option為 `< 0.8 ms` 至 `< 1.4 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721`、run mode live 為 `< 4.0 ms`。
- Level setting range：`100 kHz ≤ f < 1 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +8 dBm`；`1 MHz ≤ f < 3 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +13 dBm`；`3 MHz ≤ f ≤ 67 GHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +30 dBm`。
- Standard performance SSB phase noise 條件：CW，carrier offset `20 kHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 Hz`，level `10 dBm` 或 maximum specified output power 兩者較低者；`f = 1 GHz` 為 `< –134 dBc`，typ. `–140 dBc`。
- `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` ultra low phase noise 在 `1 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–144 dBc`，typ. `–150 dBc`；在 `67 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–105 dBc`，typ. `–111 dBc`。
- Pulse modulation 需 `R&S®SMW-K22`；一般 on/off ratio `> 80 dB`，部分高頻條件例外為 `> 65 dB`。
- Pulse rise/fall time（10 % / 90 % of RF amplitude）：低頻 frequency options fast transition `< 10 ns`；多數 20 GHz 以上 options fast transition `< 15 ns`；smoothed transition 多數條件 `< 200 ns`。
- Internal baseband I/Q、wideband baseband (`R&S®SMW-B13XT`)、I/Q wideband on：`f > 2.5 GHz` 時 `±1 GHz`；RF modulation bandwidth 可達 `2 GHz`。

Anritsu › Battle card 中的弱點敘事
[[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 對 Anritsu 的主要弱點敘事如下：

- Fragmented hardware architecture：FR1 / FR2 / FR3 需多 RF boards；source 列 boards 021/022/023/024/031/032/033，另一處另列 041。
- Early multi-box dependency：FR2、high CA、mobility 被描述為 often require multiple MT8000As。
- No integrated fading / external IP tools：source 稱 IP Option 012 + external PC；fading 需要 external PC software / chambers / software。
- Software fragmentation：SSNR、RTD、ATS、MX844030PC 被描述為 disconnected tools。
- LTE RF requires [[Anritsu MT8821C]]：source 稱 MT8000A cannot replace MT8821C for legacy RF。
- FR3 headroom：source 稱 Anritsu FR3 module supports only 0.4–16 GHz，限制 future 6G / FR3 evaluations beyond 16 GHz。

NTN signal generator solutions › End-to-end system testing
來源將 E2E system testing 描述為對 UE、NTN payload、service link channel emulator 與 feeder link channel emulator 的 RF satellite link emulation。[[R&S SMW200A]] 需要 firmware version ≥ 5.30，並透過 B14 或 B15 搭配 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 支援：

- satellite trajectory modelling。
- frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- longer path delays。
- enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- up to 1073 ms delay。
- up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

[[R&S Space Nexus]] 在來源中被描述為 PC Software，available on request，可依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files。

詳見 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

### Short answer
To compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense, we need a same-scope evidence bundle: a directly stated A&D use case, formal R&S product/configuration evidence, formal competitor product/configuration evidence, and identical test methods, options, versions, limits, and conditions; internal battle cards or separate co-mentions are not enough for unsupported superiority claims [7][11][57][81].
### Evidence required
| Evidence required | What it must contain | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| A direct Aerospace / Defense use-case source | The source must name the A&D scenario, DUT or application, and the required Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer roles in that same context [97][99]. | The provided raw material shows an “Aerospace & Defense Test” context in one slide and separately lists “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer,” but it does not itself provide a complete competitor comparison [97][99]. | Current passages do not provide a single supported R&S-vs-competitor A&D Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer comparison [97][99]. |
| Formal R&S Signal Generator evidence | R&S SMW200A evidence should come from the configuration guide and specifications, including document code, version, date, mandatory configuration, ordering information, options, RF/baseband performance, interfaces, and environmental data [2]. | SMW200A product data is conditioned on storage, warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments, and only specified/warranted data should be used as binding performance evidence [3]. | SMW200A facts available include architecture, up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth with wideband baseband, and up to 800 MHz channel emulation bandwidth with integrated fading, subject to option licensing and configuration [1]. |
| Formal R&S Signal Analyzer evidence | R&S FSW evidence should use the FSW specifications document PD 5215.6749.22, Version 17.01, September 2025, noting that data without tolerance limits is not binding and specifications may change [67]. | FSW product data also depends on storage, warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments, so comparison claims need the same conditions and calibration basis [66]. | FSW model frequency ranges and order numbers are available from FSW8 through FSW85, including FSW85 with FSW-B90G extension to 90 GHz [69]. |
| R&S option stack and configuration evidence | The comparison must list exact R&S options, order numbers where available, bandwidth options, firmware/license options, and compatibility limits rather than only naming the platform [6][70]. | SMW200A ordering requires at least an RF path A frequency option and a signal routing/baseband main module, and RF path A frequency options cannot be retrofitted [65]. | Recommended or solution-level configurations are not a quotable BOM unless checked against configuration guides, option availability, export control, and service plans [81]. |
| Application-level R&S evidence for the specific test | If the A&D use case is satellite payload/component testing, R&S application evidence states that FSW + SMW200A is positioned for complete payload testing, while ZNA is positioned for component-level testing [28][43]. | For group delay, the cited method uses SMW200A to generate a multicarrier continuous-wave stimulus and FSW to perform reference calibration and DUT group delay/gain measurement [29]. | This supports satellite payload/component testing, but it does not by itself prove a broader A&D market comparison or competitor superiority [43]. |
| Competitor official product evidence | For Keysight, the evidence must include Keysight official datasheets or third-party data validating SKU specs, document version, order number, option code, release status, and test conditions [7]. | The Keysight battle card is an R&S source, and the knowledge base says its Keysight competitor descriptions require Keysight official or third-party verification [7]. | The Keysight page records the R&S battle-card view only and states it is not Keysight official data [74]. |
| Competitor official product evidence if Anritsu is the competitor | For Anritsu, frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option code, software tools, and support model must be verified with Anritsu official datasheets, release notes, or support terms [11]. | The Anritsu page says its current content is based on an R&S internal battle card and that Anritsu weakness narratives cannot be treated as Anritsu official specifications or market facts [11]. | The battle card lists Anritsu products and weakness narratives, but the passages do not provide Anritsu official datasheet versions or validated option stacks [76][77]. |
| Same test method and measurement conditions | The comparison must state identical DUT, waveform, frequency range, bandwidth, detector or measurement mode, uncertainty, calibration interval, environmental conditions, and pass/fail criteria where applicable [3][66]. | Product data conditions differ from informal application claims, and solution-level slide claims must not replace formal datasheets or configuration guides [57]. | Equipment recommendation passages warn that formal frequency range, options, uncertainty, and test method must be checked in product datasheets [19][22]. |
| Standards and regulatory basis, if the comparison is about compliance | The comparison must cite exact applicable standards or regulations, test items, versions, and measurement scope, such as FCC/ANSI/IEEE items or 3GPP conformance chapters where relevant [53][54][55][60]. | A standards claim is not the same as a product capability claim, and each supported instrument/option configuration still needs product evidence [57]. | Some sources list regulatory or 3GPP test contexts, but they also include unresolved limits such as missing standard versions, test methods, or accepted evidence details [52]. |
| Claim boundaries for market, ecosystem, TCO, or superiority | Claims such as market dominance, ecosystem partnerships, “only vendor,” R&S superiority, or lower TCO require external evidence and cannot be based only on internal battle-card positioning [7][11]. | The Keysight unresolved section says ecosystem partnerships, market dominance, NTN/RedCap/FR3/6G path claims lack traceable external evidence [7]. | The Anritsu page says R&S superiority, only-vendor, and lower-TCO statements are sales positioning rather than directly citable technical specifications [11]. |
### Minimum evidence package before making the comparison
1. A single A&D scenario definition naming the DUT, test objective, frequency range, bandwidth, signal type, environment, and whether the role is signal generation, signal analysis, or both [97][99].  
2. R&S SMW200A and FSW formal datasheet/configuration evidence with document versions, option codes, order numbers where available, performance conditions, and warranted versus non-warranted data clearly separated [2][3][6][67].  
3. Competitor official datasheets, release notes, configuration guides, support terms, or third-party measurements for the exact competing model and option stack [7][11].  
4. A common test method with the same DUT, setup, calibration status, environmental conditions, uncertainty basis, waveform, bandwidth, frequency range, and pass/fail criteria [3][66][19][22].  
5. External proof for any non-technical claims such as market leadership, ecosystem reach, roadmap advantage, support superiority, or TCO [7][11][74].  
### Unsupported without more evidence
A claim that our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution is better than a competitor for Aerospace / Defense is not supported by the provided passages unless the exact competitor, A&D use case, R&S configuration, competitor configuration, and common test conditions are documented in directly comparable sources [7][11][57][81].

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。

- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。

Keysight
[[Keysight]]（圖中亦寫作 [[是德科技]]）是在既有 PCB 測試圖像來源中被列為高頻高速 [[PCB]] 測試解決方案相關公司的測試量測廠商名稱；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中，Keysight 也被描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor 與 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 wireless device testing 競品供應商。

Keysight › R&S 2026-02-26 battle card 中的 Keysight 描述
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Keysight 被描述為 large US-based test & measurement vendor，總部位於 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**。
- 來源說 Keysight 在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具 strong market presence。
- 來源說 Keysight 在美國與 key semiconductor accounts 很強，並宣稱有 broad ecosystem partnerships：24/25 top tech companies、14/15 operators、25/25 semiconductor companies。
- 來源列出 Keysight portfolio：[[Keysight UXM]] 5G Wireless Test Platforms（[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]）、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源說 Keysight UXM portfolio fragmented across multiple hardware SKUs，每個 SKU 有不同 bandwidth、RF ports、Wi-Fi、Rel-17/18 capabilities。
- 來源說 Keysight software model 分散於 Atlas、Channel Studio、RaySim、Nemo、WLAN tools 與 UXM-specific feature options，並稱 no unified automation environment。
- 來源說 Keysight support model 使用 tiered [[KeysightCare]] model：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support，另有 optional warranty and calibration assurance plan。

Anritsu
[[Anritsu]] 是一間日本 test & measurement vendor；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中被描述為 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 的競品供應商。

- 本頁目前只依 R&S 內部 battle card 建立；不能把 source 對 Anritsu 的弱點敘事視為 Anritsu 官方規格或市場事實。

- Headquarters：Kanagawa, Japan。
- Company size：約 4,000+ employees global。

- Strengths：good LTE/eCall signaling（[[Anritsu MD8475B]]）、solid RF heritage、strong Japanese operator relationships。
- Support model：traditional hardware service；source 評為 software ecosystem 較弱、cloud capabilities limited，且 TestDeck 是唯一 DX tool。

以上為 R&S internal battle card 對競品的描述；來源未引用 Anritsu 官方文件或第三方市場資料。

NTN signal generator solutions › 與 NTN validation / conformance 的關係
- [[5G NTN validation and testing]]：較寬的 NTN validation、partner collaboration、CMX500 / SMBV100B / Viasat / Gatehouse / MediaTek PR 語境。
- [[NR-NTN conformance testing]]：偏 UE / GCF / PTCRB / TS8980 / CMX500 conformance validation。
- [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]：本來源新增的 Satellite Access Node 測試概念，聚焦 SAN transmitter、receiver、performance 與 OTA chapters。
- [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]]：既有 CMX500 PR 中 propagation emulation 與 fading 的概念；本來源補充 SMW200A dynamic fading / Doppler / path delay 實作線索。

NTN signal generator solutions
[[NTN signal generator solutions]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025；末頁標示 Last updated: 08/25）中用來整理 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]] 與相關 software options 在 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 測試中的 solution-level 應用框架。

NTN signal generator solutions › 來源中的 solution 分層
[[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] 將 NTN testing 分為四類：

- Component Testing。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）Testing。
- End-to-end System Testing。
- User Equipment（UE）Testing。

來源可讀內容主要展開前三者，尤其是 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 channel emulation、[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 與 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › 重點摘要
此來源是由 `3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR.pptx` 轉出的 lossy markdown；封面標示 `1GP` 與 `12-2025`，末頁標示 `Last updated: 08/25`，其中 slide 27 另標示 `2025-09-29 Nokia Workshop at R&S - SigGen Product Update`。本頁以來源原文呈現的 2025 年簡報語境處理，不自行推論正式發布日。

簡報主題是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 針對 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 的 signal generator / channel emulation 測試方案，涵蓋：

- [[5G NTN-NR]] 的 Release 17 / 18 / 19 演進與頻段。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）conformance testing。
- [[NTN signal generator solutions]] 的 component testing、SAN testing、end-to-end system testing 與 UE testing 分層。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 作為 channel emulator / signal generator 的 NTN 測試能力。
- [[R&S FSW]] 與 [[R&S FSVA3000]] 在 component testing / SAN transmitter measurement 中的角色。
- [[R&S Space Nexus]] 依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files 的待請求 PC software 線索。

[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 列出 key steps：

- Functional test：power on、stow、normal / obstructed state check。
- RF emissions：anechoic chamber、FCC Part 15 / 25 limits、spurious <-43 dBc。
- EIRP / G/T：spectrum analyzer + power meter measurement、validate against target。
- Modulation BER：connect to gateway simulator、QPSK / 64QAM threshold test。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 典型 setup 元件
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 的 TVAC test setup 可包含：

- signal generator
- RF switching matrix
- signal analyzer
- network analyzer
- multimeter
- DC power system
- laptop / PC remote operation
- test interface
- TVAC
- satellite or satellite components

來源標示 TVAC setup 中距離為 10 m to 25 m。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 測試問題
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- Satellite payload qualification 需要使用 [[TVAC]] 進行 performance testing。
- Commercial off-the-shelf test and measurement equipment 無法在 TVAC conditions 下工作。
- Spectrum analyzers、vector network analyzers、signal generators 等設備必須留在 TVAC 外部，並以長 cables 連接 chamber 內的 DUT。
- Test setup 中的 cables、adapters 與 switches 會隨 TVAC temperature changes 發生 drift。
- 在不同 temperature 下於 chamber 中完成的 calibration 不再有效。
- 移動 cables 與改變 temperatures 後，需要 regular recalibration 以確保 measurement accuracy。
- TVAC 內 calibration procedure 特別困難，因 vacuum applied 時 operator 無法進入 chamber。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 [[Randy Schnell]] 製作 / 主講的 company restricted 簡報，題為 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient；raw frontmatter 顯示原檔為 `2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`，轉檔日期為 2026-09-17。來源正文沒有另外標示正式發布日期；本頁以檔名 / raw title 的 2025-12-19 作為來源日期線索。

簡報主張的核心問題是：在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，能否利用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] 能力，讓 unmodified 5G DUT connection 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具韌性。

主要內容如下：

- 任務背景：tactical edge connectivity 對資料與低延遲需求提高，[[Smart Jamming]] 與 electronic warfare（[[EW]]）威脅增加，private [[5G]] networks 在 military bases / tactical environments 的採用升高。
- 技術映射：來源將問題映射到 5G handover（[[HO]]）signaling 與 frequency-hopping（[[FH]]）signaling；測試設計需使用 [[UE]] capabilities message 回報的 supported bands，並關注 [[3GPP TS 38.300]] 定義的 handover interruption intervals。
- 測試結果：來源聲稱 both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；throughput 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 支撐 video-call reliability 維持，但投影片 OCR 未提供具體 throughput、jitter、packet loss、bandwidth、jammer profile 或 modem 型號數值。
- 現有 defense / Future-G program 脈絡：來源列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]]、[[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing 等項目，說明 FHSS / frequency-agile operation 與 5G / 6G coexistence 的整合方向。
- 時程展望：來源給出 short term 2025–2028、mid term 2028–2032、long term 2032–2035+ 三段式展望，包含 5G tactical networks scale-out、mmWave phased arrays field testing、5G/6G-capable SD radios、early ISAC for drone detection / perimeter defense、URLLC for autonomy、full 6G with integrated sensing、AI-native battlefield connectivity 與 spectrum-aware autonomy。
- Call to action：重新接觸既有 CMX customers，尤其 DOW customers；與 integrators 溝通；保持 tactical patience；提早 engage BDM organization；跨團隊分享 lessons learned。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

SDR-assisted UAV security › GPS spoofing / jamming detection
來源指出 affordable SDR devices，如 [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF 2.0]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，可用於 GNSS spoofing / jamming attacks，也可用於測試 defense mechanisms：

- [62] 提出 lightweight LSTM-based detection model，並以 knowledge distillation 壓縮，利於整合進 UAV control systems。
- [63] 研究 [[HackRF One]] 1.0 與 external TCXO 對 GNSS signal spoofing / jamming threats 的影響；受測 UAV GNSS receivers 包含 3DR IRIS+、Tarot 650 v2.2、DJI Inspire、Sky Hunter。
- [64] [[MAVIDS]] 使用 PCA 與 one-class classifiers，並以 [[HackRF One]]、[[GPS-SDR-SIM]] 與 [[GNU Radio Companion]] 進行 GPS spoofing / jamming experiments；macro-averaged F1 scores 為 GPS spoofing 90.57%、jamming 94.3%。
- [66] 使用 cellular BS 與 Wi-Fi AP crowd-sourced information 進行 GPS spoofing detection / mitigation，並以 [[HackRF One]] + TCXO 產生 spoofing signals。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。

- 來源以 [[ITU-R SM.329-12]] 與 [[47 CFR §2.1057]] 對照 CE RED / FCC 的 frequency range：5G NR FR1 的 CE RED 30 MHz–26 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–40 GHz；5G NR FR2 的 CE RED 30 MHz–90 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–200 GHz；並提到 [[R&S FSV3000]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S ESW]]。

Anritsu › Battle card 中的弱點敘事
[[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 對 Anritsu 的主要弱點敘事如下：

- Fragmented hardware architecture：FR1 / FR2 / FR3 需多 RF boards；source 列 boards 021/022/023/024/031/032/033，另一處另列 041。

- LTE RF requires [[Anritsu MT8821C]]：source 稱 MT8000A cannot replace MT8821C for legacy RF。
- FR3 headroom：source 稱 Anritsu FR3 module supports only 0.4–16 GHz，限制 future 6G / FR3 evaluations beyond 16 GHz。

### Short answer
To compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense, we need a same-scope evidence bundle: a directly stated A&D use case, formal R&S product/configuration evidence, formal competitor product/configuration evidence, and identical test methods, options, versions, limits, and conditions; internal battle cards or separate co-mentions are not enough for unsupported superiority claims [7][11][57][81].
### Evidence required
| Evidence required | What it must contain | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| A direct Aerospace / Defense use-case source | The source must name the A&D scenario, DUT or application, and the required Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer roles in that same context [97][99]. | The provided raw material shows an “Aerospace & Defense Test” context in one slide and separately lists “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer,” but it does not itself provide a complete competitor comparison [97][99]. | Current passages do not provide a single supported R&S-vs-competitor A&D Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer comparison [97][99]. |
| Formal R&S Signal Generator evidence | R&S SMW200A evidence should come from the configuration guide and specifications, including document code, version, date, mandatory configuration, ordering information, options, RF/baseband performance, interfaces, and environmental data [2]. | SMW200A product data is conditioned on storage, warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments, and only specified/warranted data should be used as binding performance evidence [3]. | SMW200A facts available include architecture, up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth with wideband baseband, and up to 800 MHz channel emulation bandwidth with integrated fading, subject to option licensing and configuration [1]. |
| Formal R&S Signal Analyzer evidence | R&S FSW evidence should use the FSW specifications document PD 5215.6749.22, Version 17.01, September 2025, noting that data without tolerance limits is not binding and specifications may change [67]. | FSW product data also depends on storage, warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments, so comparison claims need the same conditions and calibration basis [66]. | FSW model frequency ranges and order numbers are available from FSW8 through FSW85, including FSW85 with FSW-B90G extension to 90 GHz [69]. |
| R&S option stack and configuration evidence | The comparison must list exact R&S options, order numbers where available, bandwidth options, firmware/license options, and compatibility limits rather than only naming the platform [6][70]. | SMW200A ordering requires at least an RF path A frequency option and a signal routing/baseband main module, and RF path A frequency options cannot be retrofitted [65]. | Recommended or solution-level configurations are not a quotable BOM unless checked against configuration guides, option availability, export control, and service plans [81]. |
| Application-level R&S evidence for the specific test | If the A&D use case is satellite payload/component testing, R&S application evidence states that FSW + SMW200A is positioned for complete payload testing, while ZNA is positioned for component-level testing [28][43]. | For group delay, the cited method uses SMW200A to generate a multicarrier continuous-wave stimulus and FSW to perform reference calibration and DUT group delay/gain measurement [29]. | This supports satellite payload/component testing, but it does not by itself prove a broader A&D market comparison or competitor superiority [43]. |
| Competitor official product evidence | For Keysight, the evidence must include Keysight official datasheets or third-party data validating SKU specs, document version, order number, option code, release status, and test conditions [7]. | The Keysight battle card is an R&S source, and the knowledge base says its Keysight competitor descriptions require Keysight official or third-party verification [7]. | The Keysight page records the R&S battle-card view only and states it is not Keysight official data [74]. |
| Competitor official product evidence if Anritsu is the competitor | For Anritsu, frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option code, software tools, and support model must be verified with Anritsu official datasheets, release notes, or support terms [11]. | The Anritsu page says its current content is based on an R&S internal battle card and that Anritsu weakness narratives cannot be treated as Anritsu official specifications or market facts [11]. | The battle card lists Anritsu products and weakness narratives, but the passages do not provide Anritsu official datasheet versions or validated option stacks [76][77]. |
| Same test method and measurement conditions | The comparison must state identical DUT, waveform, frequency range, bandwidth, detector or measurement mode, uncertainty, calibration interval, environmental conditions, and pass/fail criteria where applicable [3][66]. | Product data conditions differ from informal application claims, and solution-level slide claims must not replace formal datasheets or configuration guides [57]. | Equipment recommendation passages warn that formal frequency range, options, uncertainty, and test method must be checked in product datasheets [19][22]. |
| Standards and regulatory basis, if the comparison is about compliance | The comparison must cite exact applicable standards or regulations, test items, versions, and measurement scope, such as FCC/ANSI/IEEE items or 3GPP conformance chapters where relevant [53][54][55][60]. | A standards claim is not the same as a product capability claim, and each supported instrument/option configuration still needs product evidence [57]. | Some sources list regulatory or 3GPP test contexts, but they also include unresolved limits such as missing standard versions, test methods, or accepted evidence details [52]. |
| Claim boundaries for market, ecosystem, TCO, or superiority | Claims such as market dominance, ecosystem partnerships, “only vendor,” R&S superiority, or lower TCO require external evidence and cannot be based only on internal battle-card positioning [7][11]. | The Keysight unresolved section says ecosystem partnerships, market dominance, NTN/RedCap/FR3/6G path claims lack traceable external evidence [7]. | The Anritsu page says R&S superiority, only-vendor, and lower-TCO statements are sales positioning rather than directly citable technical specifications [11]. |
### Minimum evidence package before making the comparison
1. A single A&D scenario definition naming the DUT, test objective, frequency range, bandwidth, signal type, environment, and whether the role is signal generation, signal analysis, or both [97][99].  
2. R&S SMW200A and FSW formal datasheet/configuration evidence with document versions, option codes, order numbers where available, performance conditions, and warranted versus non-warranted data clearly separated [2][3][6][67].  
3. Competitor official datasheets, release notes, configuration guides, support terms, or third-party measurements for the exact competing model and option stack [7][11].  
4. A common test method with the same DUT, setup, calibration status, environmental conditions, uncertainty basis, waveform, bandwidth, frequency range, and pass/fail criteria [3][66][19][22].  
5. External proof for any non-technical claims such as market leadership, ecosystem reach, roadmap advantage, support superiority, or TCO [7][11][74].  
### Unsupported without more evidence
A claim that our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution is better than a competitor for Aerospace / Defense is not supported by the provided passages unless the exact competitor, A&D use case, R&S configuration, competitor configuration, and common test conditions are documented in directly comparable sources [7][11][57][81].

Starlink User Terminal › Recommended RF test equipment
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 推薦：

- Spectrum analyzer：[[R&S FSW]]（43.5 GHz、POI 0.46 µs）、Keysight N9040B UXA。
- Signal generator：[[R&S SMW200A]]（100 kHz–31.8 GHz）、Keysight E8257D PSG。
- Power meter：[[R&S NRX]] with NRP33S（±2.5 dB abs）、Bird 43 wattmeter。
- VNA：Keysight PNA-X（67 GHz）、[[R&S ZNA]] for array calibration。
- Satellite simulator：Terma Ku/Ka-band for loopback EIRP / G/T testing。

這些是該 deck 的推薦清單；正式頻率範圍、POI、功率不確定度、option 需求與 order number 必須回查各產品 datasheet。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源指出 smartphone Art 3.3g / [[Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019-320]] / E112 是沒有 ETSI EN standard 的 regulatory compliance requirement；當沒有 EN standard available 時需 Notified body involved，並稱 [[R&S TS-LBS]] 是 first test solution available to perform the necessary LBS compliance tests。
- [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]部分列出 [[47 CFR]]、[[ANSI C63.26]]、[[ANSI C63.10]]、[[IEEE Std 1528-2013]]、[[C63.19]] 等測試依據，並列出 licensed cellular CFR47 test items：RF power output、modulation characteristics、occupied bandwidth、band edge、spurious emissions、frequency stability、peak to average ratio、field strength of spurious radiation。
- 來源以 [[ITU-R SM.329-12]] 與 [[47 CFR §2.1057]] 對照 CE RED / FCC 的 frequency range：5G NR FR1 的 CE RED 30 MHz–26 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–40 GHz；5G NR FR2 的 CE RED 30 MHz–90 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–200 GHz；並提到 [[R&S FSV3000]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S ESW]]。
- [[NTN 裝置法規測試]]部分把 NTN device implementation 分成 proprietary、3GPP < R16、3GPP R17 NTN-IoT、reuse spectrum assets / 3GPP unmodified UE 等路徑，例子包含 iPhone 14 / Globalstar、Qualcomm / Iridium、MTK / Bullitt / Skylo、AT&T / AST Space Mobile、T-Mobile / Starlink、Optus / Lynk。
- 來源列出衛星 / NTN 相關 EN standards：[[EN 301 441]]、[[EN 301 442]]、[[EN 301 444]]、[[EN 301 681]]、[[EN 302 574]]、[[EN 303 981]]，並將 iPhone14、Bullitt defy satellite link、StarLink Dish 作為 DoC / market product examples。
- 來源將 [[EN 301 681]] 測試偏向 conducted measurement，列出 spectrum analyzer、signal generator、BER measure / system emulator / mobile radio tester 等 required instruments，並明示 latest [[R&S CMW500]] software can support 3GPP R17 NB-NTN signalling。

Anritsu › Battle card 中的弱點敘事
[[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 對 Anritsu 的主要弱點敘事如下：

- Fragmented hardware architecture：FR1 / FR2 / FR3 需多 RF boards；source 列 boards 021/022/023/024/031/032/033，另一處另列 041。
- Early multi-box dependency：FR2、high CA、mobility 被描述為 often require multiple MT8000As。

- LTE RF requires [[Anritsu MT8821C]]：source 稱 MT8000A cannot replace MT8821C for legacy RF。
- FR3 headroom：source 稱 Anritsu FR3 module supports only 0.4–16 GHz，限制 future 6G / FR3 evaluations beyond 16 GHz。
